import json, glob
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import openpyxl
files = sorted(glob.glob('inputs/**/*.xlsx', recursive=True))
print('files:', files)
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(files[0], data_only=True)
print('sheets:', wb.sheetnames)
for n in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[n]
    print(n, 'rows', ws.max_row, 'cols', ws.max_column)
ws = wb['Material']
print('Material A2:', type(ws['A2'].value).__name__, repr(ws['A2'].value), 'fmt', ws['A2'].number_format)
print('Material B2:', repr(ws['B2'].value))
ph = wb['Price history']
print('PH A2:', type(ph['A2'].value).__name__, repr(ph['A2'].value), 'fmt', ph['A2'].number_format)
print('PH D2:', type(ph['D2'].value).__name__, repr(ph['D2'].value), 'fmt', ph['D2'].number_format)
print('PH F2:', type(ph['F2'].value).__name__, repr(ph['F2'].value))
combos = Counter(); qual = defaultdict(list); n = 0; bad = []
for r in range(2, ph.max_row + 1):
    v = [ph.cell(row=r, column=c).value for c in range(1, 7)]
    if all(x in (None, '') for x in v):
        continue
    n += 1
    code, pl, cur, vf, vt, price = v
    combos[(str(pl), str(cur), str(vf)[:10], str(vt)[:10])] += 1
    if str(pl).strip().upper() == 'RETAIL' and str(cur).strip().upper() == 'THB':
        qual[str(code)].append((r, str(vf)[:10], str(vt)[:10], price))
print('price history data rows:', n)
print('combos:', dict(combos))
print('retail-thb codes:', len(qual))
for k in sorted(qual):
    print(k, qual[k])
mat = [str(ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value) for r in range(2, ws.max_row + 1) if ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value is not None]
print('master codes:', mat)
print('master minus retail-thb:', sorted(set(mat) - set(qual)))
print('retail-thb minus master:', sorted(set(qual) - set(mat)))
